hero.name: Ruben Coto
hero.summary: I build production software with .NET, React and TypeScript, backed by five years diagnosing AWS infrastructure in mission-critical environments.

about.heading: About
about.lead: I work across the stack — modular .NET backends and the React interfaces on top of them — and I came to product engineering from five years of production AWS support, which shapes how I think about failure modes and observability.

engineering.title: Engineering focus
engineering.body: Modular .NET 8 backends organised with Domain-Driven Design, EF Core for data access, and React + TypeScript front ends. Comfortable owning a feature from schema through to UI.

cloud.title: Cloud & infrastructure
cloud.body: Five years diagnosing production AWS environments across EC2, S3, EBS, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC and Route 53, with root-cause analysis on outages, performance degradation and connectivity failures.

education.title: Education
education.body: B.Sc. Systems Engineering, emphasis in Software Development — Universidad Latina de Costa Rica, expected March 2027.

certification.title: Certification
certification.body: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate. Cambridge C1 Advanced (English).

points: Escalation point for high-severity incidents, coordinating with internal AWS engineering teams to drive critical production issues to resolution.
Diagnosed complex infrastructure problems across EC2, S3, EBS, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC and Route 53.
Traced outages, performance degradation and connectivity failures to root cause using CloudWatch metrics, system logs and configuration review.
Reproduced customer issues in isolated test environments to validate fixes before rollout.
Translated technical findings into step-by-step remediation guidance for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
Subject matter expert for Tier 1 and Tier 2 associates handling Amazon Echo and Alexa cases.
Resolved hardware, software and connectivity issues beyond the escalating tier's scope.
Primary liaison between the Hardware and Software departments, shortening cross-team diagnosis cycles.

cdm.title: Consultorios Dr. Moraga
cdm.summary: A single-tenant clinical management system that replaced paper-based scheduling and patient records for a private medical practice, including the audit trail Costa Rican health data is legally required to keep.
notes: Modular monolith in .NET 8 structured with Domain-Driven Design across 16+ bounded modules.
React 18 and TypeScript front end organised with Feature-Sliced Design.
MySQL through EF Core, deployed on Railway.
Configurable per-room scheduling, clinical history and automated PDF reporting.
Audit logging built to satisfy Costa Rica's Law 8968 data-protection requirements.
AI WhatsApp booking agent built on Twilio, the Anthropic SDK, Redis and SignalR.

tucitaonline.title: TuCitaOnline
tucitaonline.summary: A SaaS platform for medical practice administration covering appointments, patient records and clinic workflows.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.intro: I'm open to software engineering roles. Email is the fastest way to reach me.
